items.difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that for an object of the derived category whose cohomology sheaves are acyclic in positive degrees on the objects of a covering family B, the cohomology at those objects is computed by the zeroth cohomology of the cohomology sheaves (statement lines 5466-5479). The proof uses the spectral sequence attached to the truncation filtration, with E_2^{p,q} = H^p(U, H^q(K)) (proof lines 5481-5492), and observes that the hypothesis kills all columns with p greater than zero, so the spectral sequence degenerates (proof lines 5492-5499). The non-formal content is the degeneration argument. The claim is H2: one spectral sequence plus one vanishing input.
